memos.content: Lead with the real Hearth workspace: projects, schedule, and memos in context.

The day panel should keep today's schedule and journal memos together.
No account. No subscription. One local SQLite file you can back up.
Press Control-Shift-H over any app to catch a passing thought.
Use the warm paper theme and keep the real UI large enough to read.
The first three frames explain the workspace, capture, and calendar drag.
Review today's decisions and next actions in the chronological Journal.
Start Friday review with the P1 and P2 projects only.
Time Machine backup and direct file copies both work with local data.
Local-first software keeps the user's data independent of the tool.
